expected_response.note: No registered bounded declarative design provides a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent for the affinity-first objective.

failure_modes: A registered edit that changes pointcloud_delta_A would alter the executing curvature without any supplied evidence tying curvature to the pair-kernel contrast, risking unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates.
Selecting a single region_index would impose a global landmark direction that the mixed-sign softmin and occupancy contrasts do not support.
Changing teacher_neighbors would alter the detached nearest-k teacher mixture without evidence that neighbor count is the operative bandwidth.

A temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit would treat descriptive time variation as a time-conditioned reward, which the rejected polynomial fits and disallowed extrapolation do not support.
Any temperature proposal would be an interface violation, not a research condition.

parameter_origins.pointcloud_delta_A: incumbent default 1.0 A; executing curvature per formula_registry
parameter_origins.teacher_neighbors: incumbent default 4; detached nearest-k teacher count

rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest signed, batch-consistent coordinate contrast is the short pair-distance shell density (pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 positive, pair_kernel_7.0 negative), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel term, so no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can express that contrast. Landmark softmin and occupancy contrasts are mixed in sign across regions and are not a shared quality axis, so no single region_index is defensible. Global shape contrasts are negative but are endpoint moment descriptors, not a mechanism, and no registered edit targets them. Centroid contrasts are weak and null after branch adjustment. Survival credit is recorded joint-head credit with decoded terminal labels unavailable, so it cannot justify an affinity-first edit. Increment and turnover diagnostics disagree in sign with whole-window contrasts and are accounting diagnostics, not causal selection effects. Observed-node trends show sign changes and strong conflicts with polynomial fits rejected and extrapolation disallowed, so a stationary whole-window rule is the appropriate form and no temporal edit is supported. Joint diagnostics and the information audit are descriptive within-selector associations, not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed. With no defensible expected advantage over the incumbent, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice.
